data.body:
**[P1] Publish the child lock before the operation**

`registeredOperations.put(...)` makes map/parallel children visible before this assignment. A concurrent checkpoint can consequently create and use a child-local lock, which is then replaced here with the parent lock. A later `get()` may attach its callback under the new lock while completion occurs under the old one, leaving the caller unregistered and allowing premature suspension. Store the final lock before publishing the operation (or make both publications atomic), and add a child-registration/checkpoint race test.
